metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-iz[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Make bob gcal sync race-proof, resettable with --force, and [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]explicit about skips[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A daily-note creation race can never again erase synced Event Tasks[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]for good, `bob gcal sync --force` rewrites a day from Google as on [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]its first sync, and every Google event sync leaves out is listed [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]with a specific reason and fix.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]gcal_sync_race_force_and_skip_reasons.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/gcal_sync_race_force_and_skip_reasons.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-iz[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-iz/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Refuse to sync into a note Templater has not rendered[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]templater_guard[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]templater_guard: bob-cli. Detect pending Templater tags in the daily [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]note and return a structured `waiting` (note_missing / pomodoros_missing[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]/ note_unrendered) instead of writing, including on the locked re-read. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]See plan section "Phase templater_guard".[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Start the create hook only after Templater finishes[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]ledger_tools_readiness[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ledger_tools_readiness: bob-plugins. Ledger Tools waits for a rendered, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]settled daily note before spawning `bob gcal sync` (and Gmail), calls [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`--format json`, accepts the `held` status, and surfaces waiting/held [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]notices. See plan section "Phase ledger_tools_readiness".[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Name every skipped event and stop re-tombstoning[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]skip_reasons[dim] · [dim][/dim]after templater_guard[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]skip_reasons: bob-cli. One shared skip vocabulary for sync and list; [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sync lists every left-out event with reason and hint, reports in-sync [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]counts, stops re-tombstoning gone rows every run, and revives a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tombstoned row pasted back. See plan section "Phase skip_reasons".[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Add the --force day reset to bob gcal sync[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]force_reset[dim] · [dim][/dim]after skip_reasons, ledger_tools_readiness[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]force_reset: bob-cli. New force flag, `gcal.reset` journal record and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fold, a planner reset that restores missing rows with their old block [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ids and re-applies Google over present rows, beautiful reset output, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]docs, and tests. See plan section "Phase force_reset".[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Hold a replaced Events section and record the deletion policy[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]replaced_hold[dim] · [dim][/dim]after force_reset[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]replaced_hold: bob-cli. When every row Bob wrote for the day and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Events stamp vanish together, do what the replaced_events decision says [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](default: hold with status `held`), update list/doctor/docs, and write [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the decision records. See plan section "Phase replaced_hold".[/#D7D7AF]
